instruction: Write a complete XDP/eBPF program that reflects valid IPv4 UDP packets at Layer 2 by swapping the Ethernet source and destination MAC addresses and returning XDP_TX. Pass every other packet (TCP, ICMP, non-IPv4, and malformed frames) unchanged with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Swap eth->h_source and eth->h_dest (using a 6-byte temporary buffer or __u16/__u32 swaps)
Return XDP_TX for valid IPv4 UDP packets
Return XDP_PASS for all other packets
GPL license and SEC("xdp") entry point

tests.name: udp_reflect_tx
tests.description: Valid IPv4 UDP packet must swap MACs and return XDP_TX

tests.name: tcp_pass
tests.description: IPv4 TCP packet must return XDP_PASS

tests.name: icmp_pass
tests.description: IPv4 ICMP packet must return XDP_PASS

tests.name: truncated_udp_pass
tests.description: Truncated UDP header must return XDP_PASS safely

tests.name: udp_dns_reflect_tx
tests.description: IPv4 UDP DNS query must swap MACs and return XDP_TX
